cards.ex: We decided to go off the beaten track and explore some remote villages.
cards.exUz: Biz mashhur bo'lmagan joylarga borib, olis qishloqlarni o'rganishga qaror qildik.
cards.uzDef: Mashhur bo'lmagan, odamlar kam boradigan joyga borish.

cards.ex: The traffic was bumper to bumper all the way to the airport.
cards.exUz: Aeroportga boradigan yo'lda tirbandlik juda katta edi.
cards.uzDef: Mashinalar juda yaqin, bir-biriga tegay deydigan holat.

cards.ex: I can zip around town much faster on my scooter than in a car.
cards.exUz: Men skuterimda shaharda mashinaga qaraganda ancha tezroq harakatlana olaman.

cards.ex: Take the service road to avoid the worst of the highway traffic.
cards.exUz: Avtomobil yo'lidagi eng yomon tirbandlikdan qochish uchun xizmat yo'lidan boring.
cards.uzDef: Asosiy yo'lga parallel bo'lgan kichik yo'l.

cards.ex: The train station is just a stone's throw away from my house.
cards.exUz: Poyezd stantsiyasi mening uyimdan juda yaqin masofada joylashgan.

cards.ex: The city is implementing traffic calming measures to make the streets safer for pedestrians.
cards.exUz: Shahar piyodalar uchun ko'chalarni xavfsizroq qilish uchun harakatni sekinlashtirish choralarini ko'rmoqda.

cards.ex: We need to gas up before we leave for the weekend trip.
cards.exUz: Dam olish kunlari sayohatga chiqishdan oldin benzin quyishimiz kerak.

cards.ex: I'm tired, can you take the wheel for a while?
cards.exUz: Men charchadim, bir oz rulni ololmaysizmi?

cards.ex: Can you help me jump-start my car? The battery is dead.
cards.exUz: Menga mashinamni ishga tushirishga yordam bera olasizmi? Akkumulyator o'tirib qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Akkumulyatori o'tirgan mashinani boshqa mashina orqali ishga tushirish.

cards.ex: We traveled Europe on a shoestring, staying in hostels and eating cheap food.
cards.exUz: Biz Yevropaga juda kam pulga sayohat qildik, arzon mehmonxonalarda yashadik va arzon ovqatlar yedik.

cards.ex: The snowplows are working hard to clear the way after the blizzard.
cards.exUz: Qor tozalaydigan mashinalar bo'ronlardan keyin yo'lni tozalash uchun qattiq ishlamoqda.
cards.uzDef: Yo'lda harakatlanishga to'sqinlik qiladigan narsalarni olib tashlash.

cards.ex: Traveling during off-peak hours is much more relaxing.
cards.exUz: Tirbandlik kam bo'lgan vaqtlarda sayohat qilish ancha qulayroq.

cards.ex: It's difficult to merge into traffic on this highway because it's so busy.
cards.exUz: Bu avtomobil yo'lida tirbandlik juda katta bo'lgani uchun harakatga qo'shilish qiyin.

cards.ex: I'm taking a red-eye flight to New York tonight.
cards.exUz: Men bugun kechqurun Nyu-Yorkka tungi reys bilan uchaman.
cards.uzDef: Kechasi uchadigan va erta tongda yetib boradigan reys.

cards.ex: The landing was touch and go because of the strong winds.
cards.exUz: Kuchli shamol tufayli qo'nish xavfli edi.

cards.ex: We'll weigh anchor at dawn and begin our journey across the ocean.
cards.exUz: Biz tongda langarni ko'taramiz va okean bo'ylab sayohatimizni boshlaymiz.

cards.ex: She's been at the helm of the company for over ten years.
cards.exUz: U o'n yildan ortiq vaqt davomida kompaniya boshqaruvida bo'lgan.

cards.ex: We almost ran out of gas in the middle of nowhere.
cards.exUz: Biz hech qayerda benzinimiz tugab qoldi.

cards.ex: There's nothing like the feeling of freedom you get on the open road.
cards.exUz: Keng yo'lda oladigan erkinlik tuyg'usiga hech narsa teng kelmaydi.

cards.ex: Let's take the new car for a spin around the block.
cards.exUz: Keling, yangi mashinani mahallada aylanib kelamiz.

cards.ex: After a few initial problems, the project is finally back on the rails.
cards.exUz: Bir nechta dastlabki muammolardan so'ng, loyiha nihoyat izga tushdi.

cards.ex: He got a ticket for jumping the lights downtown.
cards.exUz: U shahar markazida qizil chiroqdan o'tgani uchun jarima oldi.
cards.uzDef: Qizil chiroq yonganida to'xtamasdan o'tib ketish.

cards.ex: The bus was late and the journey was a slow ride, taking almost twice as long as usual.
cards.exUz: Avtobus kech qoldi va sayohat sekin bo'ldi, odatdagidan deyarli ikki baravar ko'proq vaqt oldi.

cards.ex: Traffic is at a standstill due to the accident.
cards.exUz: Baxtsiz hodisa tufayli harakat to'xtab qoldi.

cards.ex: I always try to travel light when I fly, just a carry-on bag.
cards.exUz: Men doim samolyotda uchganimda yengil sayohat qilishga harakat qilaman, faqat qo'l yukim bor.

cards.ex: The best way to avoid delays is plane and simple: arrive early.
cards.exUz: Kechikishdan qochishning eng yaxshi usuli oddiy va tushunarli: erta kelish.

cards.ex: Despite the challenges, we need to stay the course and finish the project on time.
cards.exUz: Qiyinchiliklarga qaramay, biz yo'lda qolishimiz va loyihani o'z vaqtida tugatishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Maqsadga erishish uchun qat'iy harakat qilish.

cards.ex: I decided to take a flyer and invest in the new transportation startup.
cards.exUz: Men tavakkal qilishga qaror qildim va yangi transport startapiga sarmoya kiritdim.

cards.ex: I had to hit the brakes to avoid hitting the deer that ran into the road.
cards.exUz: Yo'lga yugurib chiqqan bug'uni urib yubormaslik uchun tormozni bosishim kerak edi.

cards.ex: I love using cruise control on long road trips to give my legs a rest.
cards.exUz: Uzoq sayohatlarda oyoqlarimga dam berish uchun kruiz nazoratidan foydalanishni yaxshi ko'raman.
cards.uzDef: Mashinaning tezligini avtomatik tarzda ushlab turadigan tizim.
